question: Does removal of the held perimeter recover the carrier pressure curve on the cold registered bilayer at reference pitch one?

review.scope: Independent local radial shell calculation and original-frame control. Formal review remains pending.
review.verdict: Scoped clear — Removing in-plane edges leaves a curvature mismatch on the specified registered, prestressed, cold triangular branch for both gap orientations.
review.original_frame_verdict: Scoped clear — periodizing the same saved frame in these two orientations reproduces the registered branch’s pressure, energy and tested in-plane stability.
